newsitem.title: UK: SOCCER-LIVERPOOL WASTE CHANCE TO GO TOP BY LOSING 2-1.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-LIVERPOOL WASTE CHANCE TO GO TOP BY LOSING 2-1.

text.p: Liverpool wasted a golden opportunity to go top of the English premier league on Sunday when they conceded a last minute goal to lose 2-1 at home to struggling Coventry.
Liverpool, who would have knocked Manchester United off the top of the table for the first time since January if they had won, took the lead early in the second half through Robbie Fowler.
The England striker latched onto a pass from John Barnes and lashed a shot past Coventry goalkeeper Steve Ogrizovic for his 29th goal of the season.
But Coventry equalised 13 minutes later through Noel Whelan and then stunned the Anfield crowd of over 40,000 with a winner from Dion Dublin.
Coventry's victory took them off the bottom of the league into fourth from last, one place above the relegation zone.
Liverpool remain third, level on 60 points with Arsenal and three points behind United, who lost 3-2 at home to Derby on Saturday.
